- `pattern_fit`: A+B — multi-site published fix across the standard and agile implementations, plus a marginal uncovered nil-`Options` panic route (crypt.go:307/417).
- Strongest lever: scope across ~11 validation sites/input shapes (agile XML keyBits/blockSize/hashAlgorithm, CBC iv/block, verifier size) with a coupled must-keep-working 0x36 key/IV padding rule.
- Biggest red flag: none triggered; main weakness is distance 0 (all sites in crypt.go) and the arguable O8 route, both noted in `unverified`.
